description: A shell script for bumping kernel versions in an OpenWrt repository, managing git operations, and handling platform/subtarget configurations.

methods.name: _msg
methods.description: Outputs a message with a specified log level.

methods.name: e_err
methods.description: Outputs an error message to stderr.

methods.name: usage
methods.description: Displays usage instructions for the script.

methods.name: cleanup
methods.description: Restores git state and removes traps.

methods.name: init
methods.description: Initializes script environment, checks repository state.

methods.name: bump_kernel
methods.description: Performs the kernel version bump, including git operations.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Main entry point, parses options, runs initialization, bump, and cleanup.
